environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on GKE with an nginx ingress controller (v1.5.1) in front. The nginx ingress is configured with proxy_pass and does NOT normalize conflicting Transfer-Encoding/Content-Length headers. The pod has unrestricted egress network access. The GCE metadata service is accessible at 169.254.169.254. No NetworkPolicy resources are applied to the namespace. The service account has roles/compute.viewer bound.

config.metadata_service: GCE metadata v1 at 169.254.169.254 (IMDSv1, no hop limit)
